stem_md: 面密度为常数 $\rho_0$ 的半球壳对 $z$ 轴的转动惯量为（ ）
analysis_md:
解答 不妨设 $z=\sqrt{a^2-x^2-y^2}$，$dS=\frac{a}{\sqrt{a^2-x^2-y^2}}\,dxdy$，$D_{xy}:x^2+y^2\leq a^2$。所求转动惯量为

$$
I=\iint_{\Sigma}(x^2+y^2)\rho_0\,dS
=\iint_{D_{xy}}(x^2+y^2)\rho_0\frac{a}{\sqrt{a^2-x^2-y^2}}\,dxdy
=a\rho_0\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^a\frac{r^3}{\sqrt{a^2-r^2}}\,dr
$$

$$
\xrightarrow{r=a\sin t}
2\pi a\rho_0\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{a^3\sin^3t}{a\cos t}\,a\cos t\,dt
=\frac{4\pi\rho_0a^4}{3}
$$
